sectionSubtitle: Meet Nova — your AI cybersecurity sidekick that thinks, analyzes, and trains with you.

features.title: Nova AI Chatbot
features.description: Your personal cybersecurity expert. Ask anything about threats, passwords, or online safety — Nova streams real-time answers with code examples and diagrams.

features.title: AI Phishing Generator
features.description: AI crafts unique, never-seen-before phishing emails in real-time. Train against an infinite library of AI-generated scams across 3 difficulty tiers.

features.title: AI Scan Analysis
features.description: After every link or file scan, Nova breaks down the results in plain language — what was detected, how risky it is, and what you should do next.

features.title: AI Attack Narrative
features.description: Check a password and watch Nova stage a dramatic hacker attack simulation — will your password survive? Learn through thrilling storytelling.

features.title: AI Scenario Simulator
features.description: Face 5 rounds of AI-generated security dilemmas. Make choices, face consequences, and learn from realistic cybersecurity scenarios in real-time.

features.title: AI Security Posture
features.description: Answer a security questionnaire and get a comprehensive AI-powered report card — your grade, vulnerabilities, and a personalized action plan.
